Assuming a simple series connection (the only way two resistors give a single measured resistance), we have R + 2R = 6.667 Ω → R = 2.222 Ω and 2R = 4.445 Ω. I will label the smaller resistor R1 and the larger R2, introduce an internal node “M” between them, and output the topology in the required JSON format.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":2.222,"R2":4.445},"connections":[["A","M","R1"],["M","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
